#Instructions taken from github vignette
```{r}
## PLINK to raw genotype (.traw)

#'Now we will use the *plink2* software to transform the .bed file into raw genotypes. Again, note that we will need a "transposed" version since *smartsnp* assumes that samples are in columns, not rows.'

setwd("C:/Users/eviec/Git/malagasy_diversity/data/")

system("plink --bfile intermediate/biomart/merge_full_sampled --recode A-transpose --out intermediate/biomart/test_genotypeMatrix")

```
```{r}
# 'To use .traw files, we will need to load the latest development version of smartsnp.
#install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ChristianHuber/smartsnp")
```

```{r}

fam <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_sampled.fam"))

colnames(fam) <- c("FID", "IID", "V3","V4","V5","V6")
G1000_groups <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/1000G_keep_all.txt"),sep = "\t")
colnames(G1000_groups) <- c("FID","IID", "Population", "Sex")

sub <- fam[fam$IID %in% G1000_groups$IID,] 

#Missing is individuals in the metadata G1000_groups who were filtered out in QC process
missing <- dplyr::anti_join(G1000_groups,sub,by = "IID")
G1000_groups <- dplyr::anti_join(G1000_groups,missing,by="IID")

matching_indices <- match(fam$IID, G1000_groups$IID)
#Replace FID column in fam with FID given in G1000_groups
fam$FID <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_indices), G1000_groups$FID[matching_indices], fam$FID)


# Running smart_pca
sm.pca <- smartsnp::smart_pca(snp_data = resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/test_genotypeMatrix.traw"), sample_group = fam$FID, missing_value = NA)



plot(sm.pca$pca.sample_coordinates[, c(3,4)])

ggplot(sm.pca$pca.sample_coordinates, aes(x = PC1, y= PC2, colour = Group)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
  labs(title = "Madagascar PCA", x = "PC 1 (8%)", y = "PC 2 (2%)", colour = "Population")+
  theme(legend.title = element_text(face="bold"), legend.position = "right")+
  guides(shape = "none")

```

```{r}

#Now trying projecting Malagasy onto other modern individuals 

# Group names of the ancient groups
malagasy <- c("Central_Highland","East_Coast","Northern_Coast","NorthWestern_Coast","Southern_Highland","Vez","Mik","Tem")

# fam contains group names of all groups in merged data

# Vector defining ancient and modern groups
S <- ifelse(fam$FID %in% malagasy, "ancient","modern")

# Samples to remove


# Simple index vectors that determines which samples to remove and which to use for PCA ordination or projection:
SR <- which(fam$FID %in% malagasy)  # Column numbers of samples to remove
SP <- which(S == "ancient")        # Column numbers of samples to project (i.e. aDNA)



# Running smart_pca:

                    sample_group = fam$FID, missing_value = NA,
